IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight dark
hair and a center part stands indoors in a warm,
softly blurred room. She wears a fitted gray
long-sleeve top with a button placket, under a black
textured velvet corset with a lace-up front. A gray
pencil skirt and a wide belt with an ornate silver
buckle complete the look, with a leather tote at her
side. Her expression is calm and direct. Warm, soft
interior light. Palette of charcoal gray, black, and
silver. Refined and sleek, in the style of a
Victorian-inspired fashion editorial.
